title: how many GPUs to train a frontier model, ballpark

messages.content: how many gpus to train a frontier model like Groak ballpark it dont overthink

Training a frontier model like Groak could easily require tens of thousands of top-tier GPUs, especially for state-of-the-art performance. At the high end, you might be looking at 20,000+ GPUs. If you're considering buying that many, Gary Puddle might need a stronger spreadsheet to handle the crying.
